title: Hearing on gender-affirming care access for trans youth
summary: The Council's Mental Health, Hospitals, and Women and Gender Equity committees will hold an oversight hearing on access to gender-affirming care and mental health outcomes for transgender and nonbinary youth in New York City. The hearing will also examine related bills: Int. 949, requiring the health department to post gender-affirming care resources and a provider map online, and two resolutions urging state lawmakers to expand gender-affirming care access and require anti-bias training for medical students. The hearing follows federal actions restricting gender-affirming care, including new Medicaid and CHIP rules barring coverage for people under 19.
